name: h2-usj
title: ESP32-H2 DevKit: ZRHP NCP
transport: USB-Serial-JTAG (the DevKit's "USB" port), any baud rate

name: h2-br
title: Espressif Thread Border Router board, H2: ZRHP NCP
transport: UART0 to the S3, 921600 8N1 with RTS/CTS on the reserved R19/R20 lines
connect: Flash through the H2's own USB port (USB1, USB-Serial-JTAG). The NCP then talks to the S3 over UART; the hub (or tbr-bridge) on the S3 is its host.
